title: The Public API has no way to list terms or the default
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, working in {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • You have a valid Public API key for the test organization, the Public API documentation from the developers (it gives the request to create, update and read a customer), and a request tool.
    For example: Postman.
  • The Public API documentation for the test organization is open.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps: 1. Look for a request that lists the shop's credit terms or its default.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: there is none: an integrator sends a term name and reads back the saved spelling. They are unchanged from before the release (no new credit term fields or rules).

The tester sends a Public API request in this case. The exact request is added once the API documentation or tech plan is shared; until then the case is held.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11679 (Story 10, Imports and Public API)

  • S10-R7: “The Public API reads, creates and updates a customer's credit term. It has no way to list the shop's terms or its default; an integrator sends a term name and reads back the saved spelling (S10-R3). The vendor API is unchanged.”
